LanguageData.HR_Protection_ZhouYouWang.label: King You's historical fate protection
LanguageData.HR_Protection_ZhouYouWang.description: King You is fate-protected until his scheduled death in the Lishan crisis and scene-locked during the military crisis.
LanguageData.HR_Protection_BoPan.label: Bo Pan's historical fate protection
LanguageData.HR_Protection_BoPan.description: Bo Pan is fate-protected until his configured death stage; no death location is assumed.
LanguageData.HR_Protection_YiJiu.label: Yi Jiu's historical identity protection
LanguageData.HR_Protection_YiJiu.description: Protects Yi Jiu's identity and survival through the Lishan crisis so later historical events can use him.
LanguageData.HR_Protection_ShenHou.label: Marquis of Shen's historical identity protection
LanguageData.HR_Protection_ShenHou.description: Preserves Marquis of Shen's identity without inventing an unattested death fate.
